$comment: The Dark Edit — a SYNTHETIC, hand-written 40-piece front-runner collection (docs/fashion-catalog-setup.md §14). Names, descriptions, sizes and the EVORA house brand are invented for the demo store; photos are Unsplash photos under the Unsplash License, credited per item. Prices and stock are synthetic (priceSource = SYNTHETIC). `rank` is the storefront's featured order: 1 is shown first.

products.name: Rider Leather Biker Jacket
products.description: The cornerstone of the edit. A classic biker cut in supple black leather with an asymmetric front zip, snap-down lapels, zipped cuffs and a belted hem.

photo.alt: Black leather biker jacket with silver zips laid flat on white linen

products.name: Engineer Buckle Boots
products.description: Pull-on engineer boots in polished black leather with a strap and buckle at the shaft and instep, contrast welt stitching and a stacked heel.

photo.alt: Pair of black leather engineer boots with buckle straps on a stone floor

products.name: Single-Breasted Black Blazer
products.description: A two-button blazer with notch lapels, flap pockets and a clean, structured shoulder. Wear it with the matching trousers or over a black tee.

photo.alt: Black single-breasted blazer on a hanger against weathered wood

products.name: Studio Zip Hoodie
products.description: A heavyweight black zip hoodie with a lined hood, kangaroo pockets and ribbed cuffs. Cut straight and slightly long for layering under outerwear.

photo.alt: Model in a black zip hoodie and black trousers against a white studio wall

products.name: Cropped Moto Leather Jacket
products.description: A cropped motorcycle jacket in black leather with a diagonal zip, notched collar and zipped cuffs. Sits at the waist to pair with high-rise trousers.

photo.alt: Woman in a cropped black leather moto jacket beside a black metal fence

products.name: Leather Trench Coat
products.description: A full-length trench in glossy black leather with wide lapels, a tie belt and a back vent that opens as you walk.

photo.alt: Woman in a long black leather trench coat in a white columned corridor

products.name: Nylon Bomber Jacket
products.description: The flight-jacket shape in matte black nylon: ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, a centre zip and a utility pocket on the sleeve.

photo.alt: Man in a black bomber jacket in front of a graffiti wall

products.name: Side-Zip Leather Ankle Boots
products.description: Sleek ankle boots in black leather with twin side zips, a rounded toe and a low block heel.

photo.alt: Single black leather ankle boot with side zips on a white surface

products.name: Oversized Tailored Blazer
products.description: A long, relaxed blazer with strong shoulders and a single button. Belt it over a dress or wear it open over denim.

photo.alt: Woman in an oversized black blazer leaning against a white wall

products.name: Double-Breasted Overcoat
products.description: A double-breasted overcoat with peak lapels and a knee-skimming length. Built to go over a blazer without pulling at the shoulders.

photo.alt: Man in a black double-breasted overcoat in front of a green hedge

products.name: Shadow Pullover Hoodie
products.description: An oversized pullover hoodie with a deep, structured hood and dropped shoulders. Brushed inside for warmth.

photo.alt: Person in a black hoodie with the hood up against white blinds

products.name: Lace-Up Combat Boots
products.description: Eight-eyelet combat boots in black leather with a padded collar, speed hooks and a deep-lug rubber sole.

photo.alt: Pair of black lace-up combat boots on a stone step against a white wall

products.name: Asymmetric Zip Leather Jacket
products.description: A sharper take on the biker: black leather, an off-centre zip, wide notched lapels and zipped chest pockets.

photo.alt: Close view of a man holding the lapels of a black leather jacket

products.name: Satin Bomber Jacket
products.description: A lightweight bomber in black satin with a soft sheen, ribbed trims and slanted side pockets.

photo.alt: Man in a black satin bomber jacket posing on a city street

products.name: Longline Belted Blazer
products.description: A double-breasted longline blazer cinched with a self belt. Long enough to wear on its own as a blazer dress.

photo.alt: Woman in a belted black longline blazer, sunglasses and black boots

products.name: Leather Chelsea Boots
products.description: Black leather Chelsea boots with elastic side gussets, a pull tab and a slim almond toe.

photo.alt: Pair of black leather Chelsea boots on a dark wooden floor

products.name: Oversized Pullover Hoodie
products.description: A roomy black hoodie with a front pouch pocket and long sleeves that bunch at the wrist.

photo.alt: Woman in an oversized black pullover hoodie by a window

products.name: Belted Trench Coat
products.description: A black trench with a storm flap, buttoned cuffs and a tie belt. Falls just below the knee.

photo.alt: Woman in a black belted trench coat walking past a dark stone wall

products.name: Quilted Shoulder Leather Jacket
products.description: A racer-collar leather jacket with quilted shoulder panels and a straight zip front.

photo.alt: Man in a black leather jacket with quilted shoulders outdoors in autumn

products.name: Shawl-Lapel Dinner Blazer
products.description: An evening blazer with a satin shawl lapel and a single-button front. Wear it with a black shirt, no tie.

photo.alt: Man in a black dinner blazer, black shirt and sunglasses

products.name: Sherpa-Collar Denim Jacket
products.description: A washed-black denim trucker jacket with a fleece collar, chest flap pockets and button cuffs.

photo.alt: Man in a black denim jacket with a fleece collar against a shutter

products.name: Slouch Knee Boots
products.description: Knee-high black leather boots with a soft slouched shaft, pointed toe and a mid block heel.

photo.alt: Pair of black leather slouch knee boots on a white background

products.name: Full-Zip Hoodie
products.description: An everyday black zip hoodie in midweight loopback cotton, with a drawcord hood and side pockets.

photo.alt: Young man in a black full-zip hoodie with the hood up outdoors

products.name: Shearling-Collar Bomber
products.description: A padded bomber in deep navy with a fleece-lined collar, ribbed cuffs and hem, and zipped hand pockets.

photo.alt: Navy padded bomber jacket with a cream fleece collar on a grey background

products.name: Wool-Blend Car Coat
products.description: A hip-length car coat with a stand collar and concealed placket. Short enough for the commute, warm enough for winter.

photo.alt: Man in a black wool car coat crossing a city street

products.name: Fitted Leather Racer Jacket
products.description: A close-fitting racer jacket in dark brown leather with a snap stand collar, quilted shoulders and a straight zip.

photo.alt: Woman in a fitted dark brown leather racer jacket and sunglasses

products.name: Heeled Leather Ankle Boots
products.description: Polished black leather ankle boots on a slim stiletto heel, with an inside zip.

photo.alt: Pair of black heeled leather ankle boots on a wooden floor

products.name: Charcoal Fleece Hoodie
products.description: A brushed-fleece pullover hoodie in charcoal with a kangaroo pocket. Pairs with the matching joggers.

photo.alt: Man in a charcoal fleece hoodie with the hood up in a parking garage

products.name: Fine-Knit Turtleneck
products.description: A slim black turtleneck in fine-gauge knit. The layer that goes under every blazer and coat in the edit.

photo.alt: Man in a black fine-knit turtleneck and checked trousers

products.name: Peak-Lapel Suit Blazer
products.description: A slim suit blazer with a pocket square slot and a nipped waist, cut to match a slim black trouser.

photo.alt: Man in a black suit blazer and trousers walking on a stone plaza

products.name: Zip-Pocket Bomber Jacket
products.description: A black bomber with a soft quilted lining, ribbed trims and zipped side pockets.

photo.alt: Man in a black bomber jacket by a riverside railing

products.name: Longline Overcoat
products.description: A long single-breasted overcoat that falls below the knee. Wear it over a turtleneck for an all-black look.

photo.alt: Man in a long black overcoat walking past a brick building

products.name: Lug-Sole Derby Boots
products.description: Lace-up derby boots in smooth black leather on a chunky lug sole.

photo.alt: Black leather lace-up boots with chunky soles on grass

products.name: Hooded Zip Jacket
products.description: A technical zip hoodie in black with a scuba-style hood, chest pocket and thumbhole cuffs.

photo.alt: Man in a black hooded zip jacket and cap on forest steps

products.name: Washed Leather Rider Jacket
products.description: A broken-in biker in washed black leather with a diagonal zip, snap lapels and snap-tab cuffs. Looks like you have owned it for years.

photo.alt: Washed black leather biker jacket on a hanger laid over black fabric

products.name: Gloss Puffer Jacket
products.description: A high-shine black puffer with a stand collar, baffled panels and an elasticated hem.

photo.alt: Man in a glossy black puffer jacket and cap against a white wall

products.name: Chunky Roll-Neck Sweater
products.description: A heavy rib-knit roll-neck in black with long sleeves you can pull over your hands.

photo.alt: Woman in a chunky black roll-neck sweater holding the collar to her face

products.name: Tonal Hooded Sweatshirt
products.description: A relaxed black hoodie with tonal stitching and a generous hood.

photo.alt: Woman in a black hoodie with the hood up among pine trees

products.name: Utility Cargo Trousers
products.description: Tapered black cargo trousers with bellowed thigh pockets and a garment-washed finish.

photo.alt: Close view of black cargo trousers with thigh pockets

products.name: Evening Blazer
products.description: A soft-shouldered black blazer to wear over a turtleneck for evenings out.

photo.alt: Man in a black blazer over a black turtleneck in low light
